d: Role Description This full-time Customer Data Interpretation Specialist role at Grupo Montekali is a hybrid position based in Capital Governorate, Bahrain, with some flexibility to work from home. The specialist analyzes customer data from multiple sources to identify trends, behavior patterns, and drivers of satisfaction, turning insights into clear recommendations for customer support and business teams. Daily tasks include cleaning and organizing data, preparing dashboards and reports, and collaborating with stakeholders to translate findings into actionable improvements in customer experience. The role also involves monitoring key customer metrics, supporting the design of surveys or feedback mechanisms, and participating in cross-functional projects to enhance customer satisfaction and retention. Consistent documentation, clear communication of findings, and adherence to data privacy and quality standards are central to this position.
q: Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret customer data, identify patterns, and generate meaningful insights.
Candidates should possess solid Communication and Interpersonal Skills to explain findings clearly and collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Candidates should possess experience in Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction initiatives to understand customer needs and contribute to improved service delivery.
Candidates should possess proficiency with data analysis tools and spreadsheets (e.g., Excel, BI tools) and basic knowledge of data visualization best practices.
Candidates should possess strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a hybrid work environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related field is preferred, along with prior experience in a customer-focused or analytics-focused role.
Candidates should possess familiarity with CRM systems and an understanding of customer journey mapping; experience in the GCC region is an advantage.
